# Model monitoring dashboard

*Client industry: fintech | Completed: 2023-08-23 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p10*

## The problem
The client was a lender unsure whether its credit model was drifting.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python, experiment tracking and a model registry, pandas, containerised deployment. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project caught a data drift incident within a day of release.
